name: Mournwake: Across the Styx
storyline: In the underworld of Greek mythology, Charon ferries the souls of the dead along rivers that separate the living from the departed. Each journey begins at the harbor, where new passengers await passage. Along the way, hostile creatures threaten the boat and its passengers, forcing the ferryman to fight as he guides them toward their destinations. For Charon, navigating the waters of the dead means serving as both a guide and a protector.
